brief.headline: Ask for ₹32.69 L/yr in savings by matching your cheapest price, and push 15-day faster payment against a cut to free up ₹1.16 Cr cash

priceAsk.summary: Get them to match the ₹290.00/KG price Shrinath Roto Pack gives you — or close to it — across the top SKUs
priceAsk.target: ₹32.69 L/yr saving by closing the gap to the ₹290.00/KG benchmark you already pay
priceAsk.basis: Their ₹294–308/KG on key items is 1.4–6.3% above your cheapest (Shrinath at ₹290.00/KG). Market asking prices run ₹205–305/kg for ORS laminate, so their price sits at the top of fair — they have room to come down. Hold them to the ₹290.00/KG floor you've proven is doable.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay 15 days faster in exchange for a price cut around 4%
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹1.16 Cr cash freed up for us if we move from 30-day to 15-day faster payment

brief.financialLeverage: They keep only 1.1% of every ₹100 they sell, so there's little profit margin to squeeze — a hard price cut could break them. But their cash is stuck for 81 days, way longer than similar firms at 46 days, so they'll value faster payment. You're 9.72% of their ₹291.36 Cr in sales — that's real buying power, enough to ask for better terms without risking your supply. Their rating is CRISIL BB+ / Stable, but they stopped sharing numbers with the agency, and they show GST filing delays, EPF payment delays, and pending legal cases — so treat their health as uncertain and keep a backup ready.

evidence.point: We pay ₹32.69 L/yr more than we need to across their laminates
Shrinath Roto Pack sells the same stuff at ₹290.00/KG; GEEP charges ₹294–308/KG
Their cash is tied up for 81 days, much longer than similar firms at 46 days
We're a big customer — our ₹28.31 Cr/yr is 9.72% of their ₹291.36 Cr in sales
They keep only 1.1% of sales as profit, so there's little fat to cut on price alone
They borrow money at rates between 1.55–9.25%, effective about 4.38%, so paying 15 days earlier is worth roughly that much to them

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter already supplying FDC in small volumes — proven and scalable second source for laminate sachets

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant doing both film and conversion — can match GEEP's volumes and tech

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Global group's India arm with pharma blister/sachet expertise and ₹222.04 Cr revenue — strong fit for ORS laminates

risks: They're 76% of our laminate supply (₹28.31 Cr) — we have no real backup today, so any squeeze could leave us scrambling; qualify a second source before you push hard
CRISIL BB+ / Stable rating was done without their cooperation, plus GST and EPF delays and pending legal cases — their real health is a question mark, so don't corner them into a cash crisis
Only 1.1% profit means a big price cut could hurt them badly; win on payment speed and volume certainty instead
Paying 15 days faster frees up ₹1.16 Cr of our own cash — make sure treasury and finance sign off before you offer it
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We want to keep growing with you, but we're paying ₹32.69 lakh more a year than we do with Shrinath at ₹290/kg — let's talk about how we close that gap and how faster payment from us can help your cash flow.
